name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn why wilderness survival and campcraft matter while tracking through the wilds.

faq.answer: Lyreena is an experienced scout who guides hunters through the wilderness. She offers practical advice beside her campfire.
At Lyreena's campfire, hunters learn to rest before traveling through the wilds.
Boosted Rest is a benefit you gain by sitting near a campfire. It helps you recover from travel and prepare for the journey ahead.
Resting by a campfire gives you warmth and time to recover. It helps you prepare for dangerous journeys through the wilderness.
faq.q: Why do you need to rest by a campfire?

faq.answer: Hunters travel through isolated wilds where taverns and safe towns may be far away. Basic campcraft helps you endure harsh conditions without exhaustion.
faq.q: Why is outdoor survival crucial for hunters?

aliases: how to finish the great outdoors
faq.answer: Sit near Lyreena's campfire and wait briefly to gain the Boosted Rest buff.
faq.q: What must you do to complete the task?

sections.body: Lyreena is an experienced scout who guides hunters beyond civilization's borders. She welcomes you to rest beside her campfire between hunts. In Azeroth's wilds, knowing how to make camp and regain your strength matters as much as tracking quarry.
sections.title: Lessons of the Wild

sections.body: A campfire offers warmth and a quiet rest from travel. Sit near the flames to gain Boosted Rest and recover energy for the journey ahead. Rest helps you survive in the wilderness.
sections.title: Campfire Respite

summary: At Lyreena's campfire, hunters learn how to rest before traveling through the wilds. They can gain the Boosted Rest buff there.
